title: The logo orbit
goal:
Thursday 5 Nov (docs/plans/2026-11-02-week/thu-no-spending-no-sending.md, beat 3). The assistants arrive as their real marks on rings around a centre: Meta, Google, Amazon, xAI, Anthropic. Krish asked that every company discussed shows its real logo, never a typed wordmark. A library device.

1. `params`: `centre?` an object slot id or nothing (the centre is left empty for another device such as `cursor_buddy` to sit in), `logos`: 1 to 8 `{id}` resolved through config/logo-registry.json (refuse an id not in the registry; never draw text in place of a logo), `chips?`: up to 6 short labels (Archivo) that fly in to the ring, `rings?` 1 to 3.
2. `enter`: rings draw on as thin token-coloured strokes; logos arrive one per stagger along their ring from outside with a drawn speed trail, then orbit slowly with `drift()`.
3. `add` with `toState` = logo index: one logo arrives (for one-per-beat timing).
4. `chip` with `toState` = chip index: that chip flies in and docks on the outer ring.
5. `highlight` with `toState` = logo index: that logo lifts (scale 1.1), the others dim to 40%.
6. `exit`: the whole orbit spins out.

## Tests
- no logo before its `add` or `enter`; every logo is an <image> whose href comes from the registry; logos are never rotated (the orbit moves their position, never their angle)
- after `highlight` only that logo is at full opacity
- tall and wide fixtures render
contract: Rules for every device (apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md): `Device({object, events, box, tokens, aspect, frame})`, a pure function of its props; state only from `stateAt(events, object.obj, frame)`, animation only from `progress()` and `drift()` with `MOTION` timing; colours only from `tokens` (raw hex refused); type roles from `HOUSE_FONTS`; no `Math.random`, no `f % N`, no wall clock; author 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 slots separately. Register the device in `devices/registry.ts` (one line) and in `config/ve/devices.json` with exactly the verbs below, and update `verbs.test.ts`. No person, no real brand mascot, no on-screen text beyond what params give. Look: the house tokens on a light ground, soft shadows, real-UI realism, as in Krish's references (light-grey kinetic explainer with a cute cursor character; app logos orbiting a central icon on rings with motion blur on arrival).
